children.title: Cycle 3 · Evaluating Peer Disagreement and Consensus Findings

detail.title: Evaluating Peer Disagreement and Consensus Findings
detail.summary: We examine the conditions under which an intelligent system should maintain its own conclusions versus deferring to peer consensus under epistemic disagreement, utilizing collected literature on conciliationist and steadfast views.

detail.title: Evaluating Peer Disagreement and Consensus
detail.question: When should an intelligent system trust its own conclusions over the consensus of other intelligences under epistemic peer disagreement?
detail.reason: Continuing structured investigation into peer disagreement and independent judgment.
